text: {"name":"rf_control_level_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Adjusts and writes the stored RF control level, clamps it at -62, and either clears the active flag or schedules another update.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"control_state","v1":"adjustment_amount","v2":"updated_level","v4":"current_tick"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":5,"meaning":"Adjustment component used to calculate the next control level."},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Stored control level, read before adjustment and overwritten with the result."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Interval multiplier used to schedule the next update."},{"offset":11,"meaning":"Active flag cleared when the level reaches its lower clamp."}]}
